command_allowlist: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('docs/jsoncarve-acceptance-contract.md'); assert p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size > 0"
python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; d=json.loads(Path('journeys/jsoncarve_acceptance_contract_manifest.json').read_text()); assert d['command_allowlist'] and d['journeys']"

python3 -c "import re; from pathlib import Path; s=Path('docs/jsoncarve-acceptance-contract.md').read_text(); hs=re.findall(r'^## (.+)$',s,re.M); assert hs==['Overview','Problem','CLI Surface','Capability Boundary','Hazard Taxonomy','Exit Statuses','Non-Goals','Acceptance Checks']"

python3 -c "import json,re; from pathlib import Path; s=Path('docs/jsoncarve-acceptance-contract.md').read_text(); d=json.loads(Path('journeys/jsoncarve_acceptance_contract_manifest.json').read_text()); ac=set(re.findall(r'(?m)^(AC-[1-9][0-9]*)\b',s)); covered={x for j in d['journeys'] if j['authority']!='exploratory' for x in j['traces_to']}; assert ac and covered==ac"

journeys.name: review_cli_and_record_framing
journeys.goal: Determine whether an implementer can derive the exact stdin-only invocation, argument rejection behavior, encounter ordering, and byte-level RFC 7464 output records without making format choices.

journeys.name: review_nested_string_lexer_rules
journeys.goal: Check that implementation can distinguish structural delimiters from string content and can implement the complete escape, control-byte, UTF-8, and surrogate rules precisely.

journeys.name: review_strict_container_grammar
journeys.goal: Verify that the contract identifies which top-level values are candidates and supplies closed strict-JSON rejection rules rather than permitting JSON5 or heuristic brace matching.

journeys.name: review_malformed_recovery_and_eof
journeys.goal: Confirm that an implementer can locate the exact resumption byte after rejection and determine output, diagnostics, and status for later valid values and truncated final candidates.

journeys.name: review_resource_boundaries_and_hostility
journeys.goal: Assess whether exact inclusive limits, first-over-limit outcomes, bounded memory, forward progress, and adversarial runtime expectations are sufficient for safe C implementation and boundary tests.

journeys.name: review_diagnostic_taxonomy
journeys.goal: Ensure every observable hazard maps to a closed code, hostile diagnostic material is escaped, offsets are defined, and suppression remains deterministic without hiding fatal errors.

journeys.name: review_io_failure_contract
journeys.goal: Check that read, write, and flush failures have implementable status and diagnostic rules and that callers are warned how to treat an already-written framed prefix.

journeys.name: review_scope_restraint
journeys.goal: Explore whether future users might mistake byte carving for scalar extraction, repair, querying, schema validation, file handling, monitoring, or a released implementation.
